usage: textos-site uses TextOS as a client would: as a tool. The drivers under scripts/textos/** import TextOS modules from a separate, pinned, read-only checkout of textos-v0; nothing is ever written into that checkout. scripts/textos/run.ts refuses to start unless the checkout sits at exactly the writer pin with a clean working tree, and prepare refuses a product pin that is not in that checkout's history, and re-checks the tree is still clean after the step.

writer.why: The V1 certification trunk (308aa32) plus CTC-CHAIN-1, validated by the CPO on 2026-10-27: a Commit-to-Content note goes through TextOS's common article review (buildArticleReviewSurface, article-cmo-v2@1 verdict, fail-closed release) with governed figures (ctc-figure-svg@0.1) and Sources cited without a link, one Source per cited document. Writer code only: the product truth an article may state stays at the product pin.

product.why: The product truth an article may state is read at this same SHA: cited commits must be its ancestors, quoted files are read at it. It is the certification candidate, not textos-v0 main, so every article stays a draft until a human review records otherwise.
